items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And the drummer was Philip Paul.

ctx.x: And the drummer was Philip Paul. And I say "shit, yeah." You know, so ah, so Bradshaw told me--say "look. You on the payroll as of right now. Sit down and listen at the band and uh, you know, and just, you know, listen at the band, man. And, and, and hear them and get started like that, you know."
